description: TI INA226 — I2C current/power monitor with 16-bit ADC, 0-36V bus voltage, programmable shunt full-scale range. MSOP-10 package. Measures both shunt voltage and bus voltage for true power calculation.
name: ina226
watch_out_for: Kelvin-connect the shunt sense pins. Bus pin max 36V. I2C address set by A0/A1 strapping.
